notes.title: Super Rocket Shootout is out on Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
Hi there dear followers! 

I'm super pleased and proud to announce that Super Rocket Shootout is finally [b]available on Nintendo Switch[/b]!!!

Play it on the go, on your TV or with tabletop mode, alone or with up to 4 friends. The game is compatible with all type of controllers including the Pro Controller and is running at 1080p/60fps. It's the best and smoothest way to experience the frantic brawls of our beloved zany characters!  

Super Rocket Shootout is available on the eShop for [b]9.99$/9.99€[/b]. Buy it directly on your Nintendo Switch device or on the 
[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/super-rocket-shootout-switch] Nintendo Shop [/url] 

I'd like to thank all of you for your support and love towards the game on Steam, because it's thank's to you that I've been able to bring the game to the heights it deserves. 
 
Thank's!

notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

I've just released a new patch for the game (currently in version 1.2.0) with the following change log:

[list]
[*][b]improved controls[/b] (double jump, dropping from ledge, throwing items above and below)
[*][b]improved shotgun damage detection[/b]: each shotgun particle can now hit an enemy, lot of bugs or glitches fixed
[*][b]enhanced effects[/b] (fixed a bug on the explosion impact, fixed shotgun particles)
[*][b]better AI[/b]: movement seems less erratic, more behaviors, better handling of items, AI no longer gets stuck
[*]a new feature, the ability to [b]take screenshots[/b] (from the pause menu): it's something I've been tweaking for my personal use but I decided to put it available to everybody. You may see the "backstage" though as it's not clamped and allows you to see around the stage.
[*][b]lots of bug fixed[/b], especially regarding achievements
[/list]

I hope you'll enjoy all this fixes and if you like the game and haven't dropped a review yet, I'd be really thankful if you could write one. Even a small one can help increase the game's visibility.

And if you have any comment, I'd more than happy to answer/help you!

Have fun!

Renaud

notes.title: First (and small) update
notes.notes:
Hi there everybody!

Just a small update to inform you that the game is now in its version 1.0.3.

Nothing fancy in this small update:

+ blood option: I've added, thank's to a user's comment, the option to turn on and off the blood projections, ideal if you want to play with kids. It's under the "Game" section in the Options.

+ bug correction: I've also corrected a bug that caused keyboard remapping to freeze the game and  forced you to relaunch.

Here it is, that's not much but if you have any comment, suggestion or bug, I'll be pleased to consider them for the next update.

Thank's!

Renaud (Oddly Shaped Pixels)
